* `bank` - The customer's bank, if provided. Can be one of `abn_amro`, `adyen`, `asn_bank`, `bunq`, `buut`, `finom`, `handelsbanken`, `ing`, `knab`, `mollie`, `moneyou`, `n26`, `nn`, `rabobank`, `regiobank`, `revolut`, `sns_bank`, `triodos_bank`, `van_lanschot`, or `yoursafe`. Possible values: `abn_amro`, `adyen`, `asn_bank`, `bunq`, `buut`, `finom`, `handelsbanken`, `ing`, `knab`, `mollie`, `moneyou`, `n26`, `nn`, `rabobank`, `regiobank`, `revolut`, `sns_bank`, `triodos_bank`, `van_lanschot`, `yoursafe`.
* `bic` - The Bank Identifier Code of the customer's bank, if the bank was provided. Possible values: `ABNANL2A`, `ADYBNL2A`, `ASNBNL21`, `BITSNL2A`, `BUNQNL2A`, `BUUTNL2A`, `FNOMNL22`, `FVLBNL22`, `HANDNL2A`, `INGBNL2A`, `KNABNL2H`, `MLLENL2A`, `MOYONL21`, `NNBANL2G`, `NTSBDEB1`, `RABONL2U`, `RBRBNL21`, `REVOIE23`, `REVOLT21`, `SNSBNL2A`, `TRIONL2U`.

<a id="action.collect_payment_method.payment_method.interac_present"></a>
### `action.collect_payment_method.payment_method.interac_present`

The `action.collect_payment_method.payment_method.interac_present` attribute supports:

* `brand` - Card brand. Can be `interac`, `mastercard` or `visa`.
* `cardholder_name` - The cardholder name as read from the card, in [ISO 7813](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/ISO/IEC_7813) format. May include alphanumeric characters, special characters and first/last name separator (`/`). In some cases, the cardholder name may not be available depending on how the issuer has configured the card. Cardholder name is typically not available on swipe or contactless payments, such as those made with Apple Pay and Google Pay.
* `country` - Two-letter ISO code representing the country of the card. You could use this attribute to get a sense of the international breakdown of cards you've collected.
* `description` - A high-level description of the type of cards issued in this range.
* `exp_month` - Two-digit number representing the card's expiration month.
* `exp_year` - Four-digit number representing the card's expiration year.
* `fingerprint` - Uniquely identifies this particular card number. You can use this attribute to check whether two customers who’ve signed up with you are using the same card number, for example. For payment methods that tokenize card information (Apple Pay, Google Pay), the tokenized number might be provided instead of the underlying card number. *As of May 1, 2021, card fingerprint in India for Connect changed to allow two fingerprints for the same card---one for India and one for the rest of the world.*
* `funding` - Card funding type. Can be `credit`, `debit`, `prepaid`, or `unknown`.
* `issuer` - The name of the card's issuing bank.
* `last4` - The last four digits of the card.
* `networks` - Contains information about card networks that can be used to process the payment. See [`action.collect_payment_method.payment_method.interac_present.networks`](#action.collect_payment_method.payment_method.interac_present.networks) below.
* `preferred_locales` - The languages that the issuing bank recommends using for localizing any customer-facing text, as read from the card. Referenced from EMV tag 5F2D, data encoded on the card's chip.
* `read_method` - How card details were read in this transaction. Possible values: `contact_emv`, `contactless_emv`, `contactless_magstripe_mode`, `magnetic_stripe_fallback`, `magnetic_stripe_track2`.

<a id="action.collect_payment_method.payment_method.interac_present.networks"></a>
### `action.collect_payment_method.payment_method.interac_present.networks`

The `action.collect_payment_method.payment_method.interac_present.networks` attribute supports:

* `available` - All networks available for selection via [payment_method_options.card.network](https://docs.stripe.com/api/payment_intents/confirm#confirm_payment_intent-payment_method_options-card-network).
* `preferred` - The preferred network for the card.

<a id="action.collect_payment_method.payment_method.klarna"></a>
### `action.collect_payment_method.payment_method.klarna`

The `action.collect_payment_method.payment_method.klarna` attribute supports:

* `dob` - The customer's date of birth, if provided. See [`action.collect_payment_method.payment_method.klarna.dob`](#action.collect_payment_method.payment_method.klarna.dob) below.

<a id="action.collect_payment_method.payment_method.klarna.dob"></a>
### `action.collect_payment_method.payment_method.klarna.dob`

The `action.collect_payment_method.payment_method.klarna.dob` attribute supports:

* `day` - The day of birth, between 1 and 31.
* `month` - The month of birth, between 1 and 12.
* `year` - The four-digit year of birth.

<a id="action.collect_payment_method.payment_method.kr_card"></a>
### `action.collect_payment_method.payment_method.kr_card`

The `action.collect_payment_method.payment_method.kr_card` attribute supports:

* `brand` - The local credit or debit card brand. Possible values: `bc`, `citi`, `hana`, `hyundai`, `jeju`, `jeonbuk`, `kakaobank`, `kbank`, `kdbbank`, `kookmin`, `kwangju`, `lotte`, `mg`, `nh`, `post`, `samsung`, `savingsbank`, `shinhan`, `shinhyup`, `suhyup`, `tossbank`, `woori`.
* `last4` - The last four digits of the card. This may not be present for American Express cards.

<a id="action.collect_payment_method.payment_method.link"></a>
### `action.collect_payment_method.payment_method.link`

The `action.collect_payment_method.payment_method.link` attribute supports:

* `email` - Account owner's email address.

<a id="action.collect_payment_method.payment_method.naver_pay"></a>
### `action.collect_payment_method.payment_method.naver_pay`

The `action.collect_payment_method.payment_method.naver_pay` attribute supports:

* `buyer_id` - Uniquely identifies this particular Naver Pay account. You can use this attribute to check whether two Naver Pay accounts are the same.
* `funding` - Whether to fund this transaction with Naver Pay points or a card. Possible values: `card`, `points`.

<a id="action.collect_payment_method.payment_method.nz_bank_account"></a>
### `action.collect_payment_method.payment_method.nz_bank_account`

The `action.collect_payment_method.payment_method.nz_bank_account` attribute supports:

* `account_holder_name` - The name on the bank account. Only present if the account holder name is different from the name of the authorized signatory collected in the PaymentMethod’s billing details.
* `bank_code` - The numeric code for the bank account's bank.
* `bank_name` - The name of the bank.
* `branch_code` - The numeric code for the bank account's bank branch.
* `last4` - Last four digits of the bank account number.
* `suffix` - The suffix of the bank account number.

<a id="action.collect_payment_method.payment_method.p24"></a>
### `action.collect_payment_method.payment_method.p24`

The `action.collect_payment_method.payment_method.p24` attribute supports:

* `bank` - The customer's bank, if provided. Possible values: `alior_bank`, `bank_millennium`, `bank_nowy_bfg_sa`, `bank_pekao_sa`, `banki_spbdzielcze`, `blik`, `bnp_paribas`, `boz`, `citi_handlowy`, `credit_agricole`, `envelobank`, `etransfer_pocztowy24`, `getin_bank`, `ideabank`, `ing`, `inteligo`, `mbank_mtransfer`, `nest_przelew`, `noble_pay`, `pbac_z_ipko`, `plus_bank`, `santander_przelew24`, `tmobile_usbugi_bankowe`, `toyota_bank`, `velobank`, `volkswagen_bank`.

<a id="action.collect_payment_method.payment_method.paypal"></a>
### `action.collect_payment_method.payment_method.paypal`

The `action.collect_payment_method.payment_method.paypal` attribute supports:

* `country` - Two-letter ISO code representing the buyer's country. Values are provided by PayPal directly (if supported) at the time of authorization or settlement. They cannot be set or mutated.
* `payer_email` - Owner's email. Values are provided by PayPal directly (if supported) at the time of authorization or settlement. They cannot be set or mutated.
* `payer_id` - PayPal account PayerID. This identifier uniquely identifies the PayPal customer.

<a id="action.collect_payment_method.payment_method.payto"></a>
### `action.collect_payment_method.payment_method.payto`

The `action.collect_payment_method.payment_method.payto` attribute supports:

* `bsb_number` - Bank-State-Branch number of the bank account.
* `last4` - Last four digits of the bank account number.
* `pay_id` - The PayID alias for the bank account.

<a id="action.collect_payment_method.payment_method.pix"></a>
### `action.collect_payment_method.payment_method.pix`

The `action.collect_payment_method.payment_method.pix` attribute supports:

* `fingerprint` - Uniquely identifies this particular Pix account. You can use this attribute to check whether two Pix accounts are the same.

<a id="action.collect_payment_method.payment_method.radar_options"></a>
### `action.collect_payment_method.payment_method.radar_options`

The `action.collect_payment_method.payment_method.radar_options` attribute supports:

* `session` - A [Radar Session](https://docs.stripe.com/radar/radar-session) is a snapshot of the browser metadata and device details that help Radar make more accurate predictions on your payments.

<a id="action.collect_payment_method.payment_method.sepa_debit"></a>
### `action.collect_payment_method.payment_method.sepa_debit`

The `action.collect_payment_method.payment_method.sepa_debit` attribute supports:

* `bank_code` - Bank code of bank associated with the bank account.
* `branch_code` - Branch code of bank associated with the bank account.
* `country` - Two-letter ISO code representing the country the bank account is located in.
* `fingerprint` - Uniquely identifies this particular bank account. You can use this attribute to check whether two bank accounts are the same.
* `generated_from` - Information about the object that generated this PaymentMethod. See [`action.collect_payment_method.payment_method.sepa_debit.generated_from`](#action.collect_payment_method.payment_method.sepa_debit.generated_from) below.
* `last4` - Last four characters of the IBAN.

<a id="action.collect_payment_method.payment_method.sepa_debit.generated_from"></a>
### `action.collect_payment_method.payment_method.sepa_debit.generated_from`

The `action.collect_payment_method.payment_method.sepa_debit.generated_from` attribute supports:

* `charge` - The ID of the Charge that generated this PaymentMethod, if any.
* `setup_attempt` - The ID of the SetupAttempt that generated this PaymentMethod, if any.

<a id="action.collect_payment_method.payment_method.sofort"></a>
### `action.collect_payment_method.payment_method.sofort`

The `action.collect_payment_method.payment_method.sofort` attribute supports:

* `country` - Two-letter ISO code representing the country the bank account is located in.

<a id="action.collect_payment_method.payment_method.upi"></a>
### `action.collect_payment_method.payment_method.upi`

The `action.collect_payment_method.payment_method.upi` attribute supports:

* `vpa` - Customer's unique Virtual Payment Address

<a id="action.collect_payment_method.payment_method.us_bank_account"></a>
### `action.collect_payment_method.payment_method.us_bank_account`

The `action.collect_payment_method.payment_method.us_bank_account` attribute supports:

* `account_holder_type` - Account holder type: individual or company. Possible values: `company`, `individual`.
* `account_type` - Account type: checkings or savings. Defaults to checking if omitted. Possible values: `checking`, `savings`.
* `bank_name` - The name of the bank.
* `financial_connections_account` - The ID of the Financial Connections Account used to create the payment method.
* `fingerprint` - Uniquely identifies this particular bank account. You can use this attribute to check whether two bank accounts are the same.
* `last4` - Last four digits of the bank account number.
* `networks` - Contains information about US bank account networks that can be used. See [`action.collect_payment_method.payment_method.us_bank_account.networks`](#action.collect_payment_method.payment_method.us_bank_account.networks) below.
* `routing_number` - Routing number of the bank account.
* `status_details` - Contains information about the future reusability of this PaymentMethod. See [`action.collect_payment_method.payment_method.us_bank_account.status_details`](#action.collect_payment_method.payment_method.us_bank_account.status_details) below.

<a id="action.collect_payment_method.payment_method.us_bank_account.networks"></a>
### `action.collect_payment_method.payment_method.us_bank_account.networks`

The `action.collect_payment_method.payment_method.us_bank_account.networks` attribute supports:

* `preferred` - The preferred network.
* `supported` - All supported networks.

<a id="action.collect_payment_method.payment_method.us_bank_account.status_details"></a>
### `action.collect_payment_method.payment_method.us_bank_account.status_details`

The `action.collect_payment_method.payment_method.us_bank_account.status_details` attribute supports:

* `blocked` - See [`action.collect_payment_method.payment_method.us_bank_account.status_details.blocked`](#action.collect_payment_method.payment_method.us_bank_account.status_details.blocked) below.

<a id="action.collect_payment_method.payment_method.us_bank_account.status_details.blocked"></a>
### `action.collect_payment_method.payment_method.us_bank_account.status_details.blocked`

The `action.collect_payment_method.payment_method.us_bank_account.status_details.blocked` attribute supports:

* `network_code` - The ACH network code that resulted in this block. Possible values: `R02`, `R03`, `R04`, `R05`, `R07`, `R08`, `R10`, `R11`, `R16`, `R20`, `R29`, `R31`.
* `reason` - The reason why this PaymentMethod's fingerprint has been blocked Possible values: `bank_account_closed`, `bank_account_frozen`, `bank_account_invalid_details`, `bank_account_restricted`, `bank_account_unusable`, `debit_not_authorized`, `tokenized_account_number_deactivated`.

<a id="action.confirm_payment_intent"></a>
### `action.confirm_payment_intent`

The `action.confirm_payment_intent` attribute supports:

* `confirm_config` - Represents a per-transaction override of a reader configuration See [`action.confirm_payment_intent.confirm_config`](#action.confirm_payment_intent.confirm_config) below.
* `payment_intent` - Most recent PaymentIntent processed by the reader.

<a id="action.confirm_payment_intent.confirm_config"></a>
### `action.confirm_payment_intent.confirm_config`

The `action.confirm_payment_intent.confirm_config` attribute supports:

* `return_url` - If the customer doesn't abandon authenticating the payment, they're redirected to this URL after completion.

<a id="action.print_content"></a>
### `action.print_content`

The `action.print_content` attribute supports:

* `image` - Metadata of an uploaded file See [`action.print_content.image`](#action.print_content.image) below.
* `type` - The type of content to print. Currently supports `image`. Possible values: `image`.

<a id="action.print_content.image"></a>
### `action.print_content.image`

The `action.print_content.image` attribute supports:

* `created_at` - Creation time of the object (in seconds since the Unix epoch).
* `filename` - The original name of the uploaded file (e.g. `receipt.png`).
* `size` - The size (in bytes) of the uploaded file.
* `type` - The format of the uploaded file.

<a id="action.process_payment_intent"></a>
### `action.process_payment_intent`

The `action.process_payment_intent` attribute supports:

* `payment_intent` - Most recent PaymentIntent processed by the reader.
* `process_config` - Represents a per-transaction override of a reader configuration See [`action.process_payment_intent.process_config`](#action.process_payment_intent.process_config) below.

<a id="action.process_payment_intent.process_config"></a>
### `action.process_payment_intent.process_config`

The `action.process_payment_intent.process_config` attribute supports:

* `enable_customer_cancellation` - Enable customer-initiated cancellation when processing this payment.
* `return_url` - If the customer doesn't abandon authenticating the payment, they're redirected to this URL after completion.
* `skip_tipping` - Override showing a tipping selection screen on this transaction.
* `tipping` - Represents a per-transaction tipping configuration See [`action.process_payment_intent.process_config.tipping`](#action.process_payment_intent.process_config.tipping) below.

<a id="action.process_payment_intent.process_config.tipping"></a>
### `action.process_payment_intent.process_config.tipping`

The `action.process_payment_intent.process_config.tipping` attribute supports:

* `amount_eligible` - Amount used to calculate tip suggestions on tipping selection screen for this transaction. Must be a positive integer in the smallest currency unit (e.g., 100 cents to represent $1.00 or 100 to represent ¥100, a zero-decimal currency).

<a id="action.process_setup_intent"></a>
### `action.process_setup_intent`

The `action.process_setup_intent` attribute supports:

* `generated_card` - ID of a card PaymentMethod generated from the card_present PaymentMethod that may be attached to a Customer for future transactions. Only present if it was possible to generate a card PaymentMethod.
* `process_config` - Represents a per-setup override of a reader configuration See [`action.process_setup_intent.process_config`](#action.process_setup_intent.process_config) below.
* `setup_intent` - Most recent SetupIntent processed by the reader.

<a id="action.process_setup_intent.process_config"></a>
### `action.process_setup_intent.process_config`

The `action.process_setup_intent.process_config` attribute supports:

* `enable_customer_cancellation` - Enable customer-initiated cancellation when processing this SetupIntent.

<a id="action.refund_payment"></a>
### `action.refund_payment`

The `action.refund_payment` attribute supports:

* `amount` - The amount being refunded.
* `charge` - Charge that is being refunded.
* `metadata` - Set of [key-value pairs](https://docs.stripe.com/api/metadata) that you can attach to an object. This can be useful for storing additional information about the object in a structured format.
* `payment_intent` - Payment intent that is being refunded.
* `reason` - The reason for the refund. Possible values: `duplicate`, `fraudulent`, `requested_by_customer`.
* `refund` - Unique identifier for the refund object.
* `refund_application_fee` - Boolean indicating whether the application fee should be refunded when refunding this charge. If a full charge refund is given, the full application fee will be refunded. Otherwise, the application fee will be refunded in an amount proportional to the amount of the charge refunded. An application fee can be refunded only by the application that created the charge.
* `refund_payment_config` - Represents a per-transaction override of a reader configuration See [`action.refund_payment.refund_payment_config`](#action.refund_payment.refund_payment_config) below.
* `reverse_transfer` - Boolean indicating whether the transfer should be reversed when refunding this charge. The transfer will be reversed proportionally to the amount being refunded (either the entire or partial amount). A transfer can be reversed only by the application that created the charge.

<a id="action.refund_payment.refund_payment_config"></a>
### `action.refund_payment.refund_payment_config`

The `action.refund_payment.refund_payment_config` attribute supports:

* `enable_customer_cancellation` - Enable customer-initiated cancellation when refunding this payment.

<a id="action.set_reader_display"></a>
### `action.set_reader_display`

The `action.set_reader_display` attribute supports:

* `cart` - Cart object to be displayed by the reader, including line items, amounts, and currency. See [`action.set_reader_display.cart`](#action.set_reader_display.cart) below.
* `type` - Type of information to be displayed by the reader. Only `cart` is currently supported. Possible values: `cart`.

<a id="action.set_reader_display.cart"></a>
### `action.set_reader_display.cart`

The `action.set_reader_display.cart` attribute supports:

* `currency` - Three-letter [ISO currency code](https://www.iso.org/iso-4217-currency-codes.html), in lowercase. Must be a [supported currency](https://stripe.com/docs/currencies).
* `line_items` - List of line items in the cart. See [`action.set_reader_display.cart.line_items`](#action.set_reader_display.cart.line_items) below.
* `tax` - Tax amount for the entire cart. A positive integer in the [smallest currency unit](https://docs.stripe.com/currencies#zero-decimal).
* `total` - Total amount for the entire cart, including tax. A positive integer in the [smallest currency unit](https://docs.stripe.com/currencies#zero-decimal).

<a id="action.set_reader_display.cart.line_items"></a>
### `action.set_reader_display.cart.line_items`

The `action.set_reader_display.cart.line_items` attribute is a list. Each element supports:

* `amount` - The amount of the line item. A positive integer in the [smallest currency unit](https://docs.stripe.com/currencies#zero-decimal).
* `description` - Description of the line item.
* `quantity` - The quantity of the line item.

## Timeouts

[Configuration options](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/language/resources/syntax#operation-timeouts) are set with the `timeouts` attribute, for example `timeouts = { create = "5m" }`:

* `create` - (Default `20m`)
* `delete` - (Default `20m`)
* `update` - (Default `20m`)

## Import

In Terraform v1.5.0 and later, and in OpenTofu, use an [`import` block](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/language/import) to import a terminal reader using its ID. For example:

```terraform
import {
  to = stripe_terminal_reader.counter
  id = "tmr_123"
}
```

In Terraform v1.12.0 and later, and in OpenTofu v1.12.0 and later, the `import` block can use the `identity` attribute instead. For example:

```terraform
import {
  to = stripe_terminal_reader.counter
  identity = {
    id = "tmr_123"
  }
}
```

### Identity Schema

#### Required

* `id` (String) The Stripe ID of the terminal reader.

Using `terraform import`, import a terminal reader using its ID. For example:

```console
% terraform import stripe_terminal_reader.counter tmr_123
```

~> Stripe never returns the `registration_code`, so an imported reader has none in state: a configuration that sets it plans a replacement unless it ignores changes to it with `lifecycle { ignore_changes = [registration_code] }`.
